notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Fixed some more causes of the "Generating..." error
 Fixed "There are too many soldiers in the destination district to transfer additional ones" bug

notes.title: Update 1.03 - FIXED "GENERATING..." ERROR!
notes.notes:
Fixed errors caused by 'comma-style' floats (found in non-US locales e.g. Germany) - these errors include:


 Campaign stuck on "Generating..."
 Being unable to move the mouse

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes: Fixed missing textures in battle / shootout modes

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Added volume slider
 Added mouse sensitivity slider
 Added adjustable AI accuracy
 Added invert mouse option
 Fixed bug where restarting a battle in spectator mode causes a blank scene to spawn
 Fixed bots spawning outside certain shootout maps
 Added a game version indicator to the bottom of the main menu

notes.title: Release Date: 7th February 2023!
notes.notes: Recruit your gang members, plan your strategy, and kill your rivals in FPS gun battles - Street Lords will be available on 7th February 2023!
